Name: Hearth and Home - Furniture (AT)
Author: hypnagogie
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/hTH9Esrm.png[/img]﻿[/center]
T﻿his pack includes all furniture for my Hearth & Home mod.  My aim was sort of retro cozy, and I did my best to make several complementary pairs/groups of patterns & colors to play with.

All the windows are seasonal and have an outside view of the foliage behind the farmhouse. Someday I will figure out Content Patcher and how to change them automatically, but til then they probably have to be manually adjusted as the seasons change.

There's a PDF catalog in the optional files that shows every item in the pack, along with the default name of the textured item. Mostly I used blue couch/armchair, winter tables & chairs, walnut dressers.

I also attempted to make an alternative option for most of the undeletable quest rewards.

[b]What's included:
[/b]
[list]
[*]couches, chairs, stools, office chairs
[*]kitchen tables, coffee tables, end tables, a kitchen island
[*]beds in all sizes, dressers
[*]bookshelves, fireplaces
[*]lamps, sconces, paintings, mirrors, wall hangings, rugs, plants
[*]seasonal windows (basic & small)
[*]a couple festive items - winter tree, seasonal fancy tables
[*]a back door (nonfunctional, sadly)
[/list]
[b]Other packs in this collection
[/b]
[color=#f1f1f1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18478]Walls & floors

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Download & install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246] ﻿Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ 
[*]Download this mod!
[*]Unzip and move both Alternative Textures and Hearth & Home - Furniture to your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]Stardew Valley Mods folder[/url]
[/list]
[b]Using Alternative Textures in game
[/b]
[list]
[*]You'll need to go to Robin's and buy a paint bucket (there are a few other tools, too, but not absolutely necessary).
[*]Place the default item (e.g. the blue armchair) in the world.
[*]With the paint bucket equipped, click on the item you want to retexture.
[*]Use the keyword "hnh" to find options from this pack.
[*]Play!
[/list]
I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10213]Furniture Adjustment[/url]﻿ if you too hate things that do not center.
